op-08443d1c3be6e196.rationale: Without a source it shows where an installed AppImage updates from. With a URL or github:owner/repo, or with --clear, it changes where future updates are downloaded from.
op-08443d1c3be6e196.saferAlternative: Run appimg update-source NAME without a source first, and confirm a new URL or github:owner/repo belongs to the application's publisher.

op-1a83df11ee5b78cd.rationale: Moves or copies an AppImage already on disk into $XDG_DATA_HOME/appimages and writes a desktop entry; one in ~/.local/bin leaves a symbolic link behind. With --scan it only lists candidates and changes nothing.
op-1a83df11ee5b78cd.saferAlternative: Run appimg adopt --scan first to see candidates, and inspect the file offline with unsquashfs -l before adopting it. adopt --dry-run is safe only from appimg 0.4.1 on.

op-1d8f2e3384b44038.rationale: Prints a shell completion script to stdout and writes nothing.
op-1d8f2e3384b44038.saferAlternative: Inspect the exact target and required permissions before running this operation.

op-227d251131facfdb.rationale: Downloads newer versions and swaps them in place of installed AppImages. With --check it only reports and changes nothing.
op-227d251131facfdb.saferAlternative: Run appimg update --all --check, or appimg update NAME --check, first to see what would change.

op-28e623ce1c945c32.saferAlternative: Inspect the exact target and required permissions before running this operation.

op-2e390f4b1131c34a.rationale: Read-only environment check that reports leftovers without deleting anything.
op-2e390f4b1131c34a.saferAlternative: Inspect the exact target and required permissions before running this operation.

op-3c5f7f4c2183d9b4.rationale: Shows a sample desktop notification right away. It changes no files, but it acts outside the terminal, so it is kept at review rather than listed as a read-only invocation.
op-3c5f7f4c2183d9b4.saferAlternative: Run appimg notify status to check the notification setup without showing a notification.

op-66ac10fbbea895e4.rationale: Opens the desktop entry of an installed AppImage in $EDITOR and rewrites it.
op-66ac10fbbea895e4.saferAlternative: Inspect the desktop entry in $XDG_DATA_HOME/applications before editing it.

op-6c69101a5444aed0.rationale: Copies an AppImage from a file or downloads it from a URL into $XDG_DATA_HOME/appimages and writes icons and a desktop entry. Versions before 0.4.1 run the AppImage even with --dry-run.
op-6c69101a5444aed0.saferAlternative: Inspect the AppImage offline first, for example list its squashfs contents with unsquashfs -l (add -o with the offset past the ELF runtime). appimg install --dry-run is safe only from appimg 0.4.1 on; earlier versions run the AppImage.

op-6df54ad180aab1a8.rationale: Stops the systemd user timer and removes both units.
op-6df54ad180aab1a8.saferAlternative: Run appimg notify status first to see which timer would be stopped and removed.

op-75eb278d6a9fb4cf.rationale: Without a subcommand appimg starts an interactive terminal interface that can install, update and remove AppImages. Help and version output are read-only.
op-75eb278d6a9fb4cf.saferAlternative: Use appimg list --json or appimg update --all --check instead of the interactive interface.

op-98ae7de9f4921295.rationale: Deletes an installed AppImage together with its desktop entry and icons.
op-98ae7de9f4921295.saferAlternative: Run appimg list first to confirm the exact application name.

op-b4d1dad95db6f6d7.rationale: Read-only report of whether the timer is on, when it runs next, how the last check went, and whether the appimg it runs still exists.
op-b4d1dad95db6f6d7.saferAlternative: Inspect the exact target and required permissions before running this operation.

op-bb0b400368c64a1a.rationale: Installs every AppImage an export file lists, downloading each one again from its recorded source.
op-bb0b400368c64a1a.saferAlternative: Read the export file and confirm every listed source first. From appimg 0.4.1 on, import --dry-run shows what would be installed and from where.

op-c1ecd601718bd5de.rationale: Writes a systemd user service and timer to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/systemd/user and starts the timer, which runs appimg once a day.
op-c1ecd601718bd5de.saferAlternative: Run appimg notify status first; enabling writes and starts a persistent systemd user timer.

op-d76e96e3251de015.rationale: Writes the list of installed AppImages and their sources to standard output, or to the given file, which it replaces.
op-d76e96e3251de015.saferAlternative: Run appimg export without a file to print the export to standard output instead of writing a file.
